profile_text.body:
Micron Technology Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boise, Idaho, traded under the ticker MU, with SEC CIK 0000723125. On its own site it describes itself as a global leader in memory and storage, powering AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge with semiconductor solutions.

The site material centers on memory and storage products and the resources around them: data sheets, design tools, technical documentation, a Technology Enablement Program, and an online source for placing and tracking orders for Micron memory samples. It also states that mobile memory and storage accelerate AI-driven technologies that it says enable predictive, insightful and new experiences for end users. No individual products are listed in the held facts.

The held facts record no lawsuits and no MCP servers. Legal exposure is concentrated in Idaho, with 21 entries.
